title: R50 and above: occupant parking averages at most 2 bays per dwelling
text: For R50 and above, maximum occupant parking does not exceed 2 bays per dwelling, averaged across the residential component of the development.

replaces.note: maximum garage and carport parking 1/2/2 per dwelling at R30+ -> 2 bays per dwelling averaged at R50+, all bay types including basement

notes: from: ch3 C2.3.1-r2. diverges: one averaged cap of 2 bays per dwelling over all occupant bays (basement and undercroft included), not a per-dwelling garage and carport cap by bedroom count. R50 and above only, so R50 and R60 in this chapter; no maximum at R10-R40. ToC says maxima apply at R30 and above (register C4P1-043).
